rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose description for a person who has never had sex.

example.english: They said they were virginal and wanted to wait until marriage.
example.traditional: 佢話自己未有性經驗，想結婚後先發生關係。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 mei6 jau5 sing3 ging1 jim6 soeng2 git3 fan1 hau6 sin1 faat3 saang1 gwaan1 hai6

rows.note: Use this when “virginal” refers to an innocent, youthful appearance or manner rather than stating that someone is a virgin.

example.english: They look virginal in their school uniform.
example.traditional: 佢着住校服影相，個樣仲好清純。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 haau6 fuk6 jing2 soeng2 go3 joeng2 zung6 hou2 cing1 seon4

rows.note: Use this for someone or something described as pure, innocent, or untainted.

example.english: The child has a virginal heart and has not been tainted by the outside world.
example.traditional: 個小朋友個心好純潔，冇畀外界污染過。
example.jyutping: go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 go3 sam1 hou2 seon4 git3 mou5 bei2 ngoi6 gaai3 wu1 jim5 gwo3
